search_text: published ZDI-09-087 ZDI-CAN-541 Microsoft Internet Explorer CSS Race Condition Code Execution Vulnerability 2009-12-08 CVE-2009-3673 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2009-3673 ['Microsoft', 'Microsoft'] ['Internet Explorer 8', 'Internet Explorer 7'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to potentially execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Internet Explorer. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page. The specific flaw exists during a race condition while repetitively clicking between two elements at a fast rate. When clicking back and forth between these two elements a corruption occurs resulting in a call to a dangling pointer which can be further leveraged into code execution via a heap spray. Exploitation of this vulnerability will lead to remote system compromise under the credentials of the currently logged in user. Microsoft has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Microsoft Internet Explorer CSS Race Condition Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to potentially execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Internet Explorer. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page. The specific flaw exists during a race condition while repetitively clicking between two elements at a fast rate. When clicking back and forth between these two elements a corruption occurs resulting in a call to a dangling pointer which can be further leveraged into code execution via a heap spray. Exploitation of this vulnerability will lead to remote system compromise under the credentials of the currently logged in user.
